_readme: AP's define-on-first-reference law, mechanized for the one slice a machine can see:
an all-caps token's FIRST occurrence on a page must sit in a sentence that glosses it
(a parenthetical, or an expansion). Two lists, both ratchets:
assumed_known = acronyms a general reader genuinely holds (adjudicated 2026-09-01);
debt = bare first references shipped before the gate existed, keyed acronym -> pages.
The edit fleet burns debt down; a NEW page or NEW acronym gets no debt entry.
POST/GET/JSON/README assumed: they appear only in the replication guide, whose reader is executing HTTP requests and knows the verbs.

chain's PAN/RFID/UV/M&A/PE/OEM/NFM/LSR/HCR/RTV entries are inside verbatim vault self-descriptions that policy forbids rewriting; they stay as permanent adjudicated debt, glossed in the methodology instead.
State postal codes assumed: household knowledge, AP-accepted in lists.
ALFRED: glossed on the page, but the gloss renders from a derived data file AFTER the first prose occurrence; reordering is a data-file edit. Debt with reason, like the vault quotes.
